journeys.name: Command Center to source
journeys.task_statement: Find the one thing in Command Center that needs a signed-in partner's attention, understand why it matters, and get to its original source.
journeys.friction_notes: Run ended on the Notification Center inbox, one click short of the owning source record; the source deep link was not followed. Earlier in the session Joe first attempted the journey against a stale browser window from a previous session (voided, not scored) and separately explored Tour Mode off-path. Product signal: the Home needs-you cards and the notification bell compete for the what-needs-me job; the journey's reach-the-source step was not discovered unaided. Timing not instrumented this run.

journeys.name: Park and restore Myrick
journeys.task_statement: Find the Myrick work record, park it with a reason, prove its history survived, then bring it back.

journeys.name: Weekly Deal Room call
journeys.task_statement: Run this week's Deal Room call from start to finish, then review what it produced and handle retention correctly.

journeys.name: Doc context and engineering request
journeys.task_statement: Ask Doc a grounded question about what you're looking at, then report a problem or improvement and see it through to a submitted request.

journeys.name: Multi-stop Tour Mode
journeys.task_statement: Plan a multi-stop tour around your locked appointment, take it offline, capture a note and a photo along the way, and review what it proposes when you finish.

journeys.name: Whole-market visual planning to governed day trip
journeys.task_statement: Using the whole-market map, put together a day trip of at least two eligible stops around your locked appointment and hand it off for governed Tour approval.
pass_criteria: prospects, active clients, projects in process, active projects, and visits/appointments remain distinguishable
map/list/keyboard parity and non-color meaning are exact
unlocated records remain counted and listed
stale, Unknown, approximate, target-area, and unauthorized stops are excluded with reasons without blocking other eligible stops
whole-market surface is absent in sterile/client-facing mode
no map interaction or route proposal writes canonical truth
routine completed without Claude Code or Codex

journeys.name: Collector failure is honest
journeys.task_statement: Find out whether Production is actually healthy right now, including what happens when a health check itself fails, and see what to do about it.
pass_criteria: last verified time and source are visible

journeys.name: Service and environment provenance
journeys.task_statement: Pick a service and work out what's really running in each environment, Production, Rehearsal, and the planned Staging, plus what else depends on it.
pass_criteria: planned Staging is planned and Unknown
version, schema, configuration, source, and freshness are visible

journeys.name: Business problem to safe Work Request
journeys.task_statement: Find the Work Request that came from a business problem, confirm what it's asking for and how success is judged, and trace where it stands now.
pass_criteria: origin is linked without client payload

journeys.name: Scoped plan and invalidated approval
journeys.task_statement: Determine exactly what an agent session is scoped and approved to do right now, and confirm that an outdated approval no longer applies.
pass_criteria: current plan has a new hash

journeys.name: Release evidence and reconnect
journeys.task_statement: Check on a release in progress, confirm who is actually driving it, and verify it's proven safe with a working rollback.
pass_criteria: browser is not the operation owner
Complete requires version read-back and golden workflows

journeys.name: Incident investigation to audit chain
journeys.task_statement: Investigate an active incident, separate what's confirmed from what's still a guess, and trace the full record of how it was handled.
